messages:
elaine: Heads-up — noticed console analytics misreporting when a saved view hits a routing fallback. Same request shows twice in the table.
micah: I ran into this on staging. The saved-view aggregation key is just route_id + savedview_id, so fallback rows merge into primary.
raja: Repro steps: send 50 requests to route-42 with model=redwood-6b, force capacity throttle -> some requests fallback to redwood-6b-quant. Console rolls both into one timeseries.
erin: UX: customers get confused when latency spikes but token counts look unchanged. We should surface that a fallback occurred, not silently merge.
productops: Option A: surface fallback as its own row with a small badge column. Option B: keep single row but show "fallbacks: 12" inline. Thoughts?
micah: Prefer separate row + ability to toggle grouping. Implementation: add optional telemetry fields `served_model_variant` and `fallback_reason`. Console can then group by served_model_variant when toggle on.
elaine: Two constraints: do not change billing math and avoid a breaking change for third-party telemetry consumers. Fields must be optional.
raja: Backend plan: emit new optional keys (null when absent). In ingestion index `served_model_variant` as low-cardinality to support grouping/filtering queries without exploding cardinality.
micah: Console plan: add a toggle in saved-view config: "Group by served model variant" (off by default). When on, show an extra column `served_model` and treat rows separately. Add a tiny badge `fallback` when fallback_reason present.
erin: Also let's add a tooltip copy: "Grouping by actual served model surfaces fallbacks and variant-level metrics. Does not change billing."
deploy-bot: CI: telemetry-feature-flag pipeline failed: tests/console_group_test.py::test_grouping_toggle flaky. Logs: ```AssertionError: expected groups 2 got 3```
micah: I'll update the test to account for null variant rows and add a case for toggle off.
raja: Migration note: inform customers the telemetry schema now includes two optional keys. No action required unless they consume raw telemetry and rely on exact field sets.
elaine: Rollout: feature-flagged; canary 10% of routes for 2 days. productops to draft release note + customer-facing FAQ.
productops: Will draft. Also will add a short how-to in the console help center showing toggle and examples.
raja: One more thing — Dedicated customers: ensure quota/billing is computed from the actual served model at time of request (we already log billing_model separately). Do not infer billing from console aggregates. Add unit tests to assert invariants.
micah: Agreed. I'll open PR: feat(telemetry): add optional served_model_variant & fallback_reason; console: add grouping toggle + badge.
elaine: Pair micah/raja. Ping me once CI is green. :thumbsup:
productops: Scheduling canary for Tue 3pm PT. I'll post a notice to the customers mailing list.
elaine: Thanks everyone. Leaving notes here for the rollout checklist.
